name: carbon/vips
reason: This Neos CMS plugin depends on rokka/imagine-vips, but a documented direct local-input API for its own package and control run have not been established.

name: mako/pixel-vips
reason: The source describes a libvips image adapter, but Packagist lists only development versions; a pinned open-source release and public local-input control remain unverified.

name: pnm1231/nic-parser
reason: PNM is part of an author handle; this validates Sri Lankan identity card numbers, not portable anymap images.

name: lukasss93/pdf-to-ppm
reason: Converts PDF input to PPM output; the documented direction does not parse a PNM file.

name: fdmind/statamic-libvips
reason: Packagist release metadata declares a proprietary license, so it fails the open-source requirement.

name: imanee/imanee
reason: The documented local-path constructor loads the P3 into Imagick but the wrapper relies on PHP getimagesize for metadata; dimensions are null and output() throws EmptyImageException on the valid control. No observable public parse result was obtained.

name: zenstruck/image
reason: Its documented ImageFileInfo::wrap(path)->dimensions() rejects the valid P3 control with Unable to parse image metadata; no successful local PNM input API was established.

name: talesoft/phim
reason: The release README marks image-file parsing as unimplemented; no local PNM input API exists in this release.

name: daniel-km/zoomify
reason: The documented process(local P3) returned true but wrote ImageProperties.xml with empty WIDTH and HEIGHT and zero tiles because the wrapper uses PHP getimagesize, which rejects this PNM control. No observable successful PNM parsing.

name: daniel-km/deepzoom
reason: The documented process(local P3) failed with Invalid image geometry; its metadata path uses PHP getimagesize, which rejects this PNM control.

name: thapp/image
reason: The documented Imagick Source::load(local P3 file) failed with RuntimeException Cannot read file; its metadata reader uses PHP getimagesize, which rejects this PNM control.
